ARTICLE XII

BASIC SCHEDULES AND RATES OF PAY

<table><tr><td>12-1</td><td>Classification of Staff:</td></tr><tr><td>12-1-1</td><td>Regular Teachers: All regular teachers plus librarians, therapists, nurses and instructional assistants come under the salary schedule and are assigned to 38 weeks of service.</td></tr><tr><td>12-1-2</td><td>More Than 38-week Teachers: Those assigned to contracts for longer terms are paid by formula or prorated salaries based on the salary schedule.</td></tr><tr><td>12-1-3</td><td>Reduced Load (Part-time Teachers): Those teachers employed for a time period less than 1.000 of a full time teacher shall be assigned a contract on which the pay shall be prorated from the regular salary schedule listed in Appendix A.</td></tr><tr><td>12-1-4</td><td>Summer School Teachers: See Appendix C.</td></tr><tr><td>12-1-5</td><td>Reserve Teachers: See Appendix D.</td></tr><tr><td>12-1-6</td><td>Creative Play Teachers: See Appendix E.</td></tr><tr><td>12-1-7</td><td>Adventure Club Teachers: See Appendix F.</td></tr><tr><td>12-1-8</td><td>Parent-Child Center Teachers: See Appendix G.</td></tr><tr><td>12-1-9</td><td>Adult Basic/Continuing Education (AB/CE) Teachers: See Appendix H.</td></tr><tr><td>12-1-10</td><td>Hourly Rate LD: See Appendix J.</td></tr><tr><td>12-1-11</td><td>Off-Campus Teachers: See Appendix J.</td></tr><tr><td>12-1-12</td><td>Hourly Rate LEP Teachers: See Appendix J.</td></tr><tr><td>12-2</td><td>Salary Schedule: The wages and salaries reflected in Appendix A, attached hereto, shall be a part of the Agreement for the 1985-86 and 1986-87 school years.</td></tr><tr><td>12-3</td><td>Extra-curricular Salary Schedules: The ages and salaries reflected in the extra-curricular schedule, marked Appendix B, shall be a part of this Agreement for the 1985-86 and 1986-87 school years.</td></tr><tr><td>12-4</td><td>Status of Salary Schedule: Upon expiration of this Agreement, the salary schedules contained herein shall have no force and effect and shall not be construed as a part of a teacher's continuing contract.</td></tr></table>
